assessment_basis: Visual inspection of the supplied rendered page. Classifications describe fidelity to the printed source, not legal applicability.

findings: The printed closing quotation mark after Transactions is a double quotation mark, ”. The right extraction substitutes a single quotation mark, ’.
The printed heading number 7. appears in the left margin before Product Category. The right extraction omits it.
issues.proposed_resolution: Retain Transactions”). and restore 7. before Product Category.

issues.printed_text: 7.1    Intermediaries should devise (or adjust as appropriate) Product Categories to categorise investment products based on the terms and features, characteristics, nature and extent of risks of investment product.
findings: The paragraph number 7.1 is clearly printed in the left margin. Its deletion omits a paragraph identifier; it is not merely a typographic difference.

issues.printed_text: 7.2    The SPI should specify the Product Categories within which investment transactions could be executed under a Streamlined Approach. Intermediaries are required to document the choice of the SPI and provide a Product Category Information Statement to the SPI to explain the terms and features, characteristics, nature and extent of risks of investment products within such Product Category (the “Product Category Information Statement” eg, in the form of an information booklet/ hyperlinks). Where applicable, the Product Category Information Statement should include warning statements in relation to the distribution of complex products. Intermediaries are also required to explain to the SPI upon request, to facilitate the SPI’s understanding of the Product Category Information Statement, terms and features, characteristics, nature and extent of risks of investment products within such Product Category.
findings: The paragraph number 7.2 is clearly printed in the left margin. The right extraction omits this identifier.

issues.printed_text: 7.3    Intermediaries should not apply the Streamlined Approach to investment transactions within a Product Category for an SPI unless –
findings: The paragraph number 7.3 is clearly printed in the left margin. The right extraction omits the identifier of the paragraph introducing conditions (a) and (b).

issues.printed_text:
7.3    Intermediaries should not apply the Streamlined Approach to investment transactions within a Product Category for an SPI unless –

(a)    the SPI has met the criteria specified under paragraph 4.1(a) or (b) or (c) above;
or

(b)    the SPI has executed within such Product Category at least five transactions within the past three years (ie, the criteria specified under paragraph 4.1(d) above).
findings: The printed dash following unless appears to be an en dash, –. The right extraction substitutes an em dash, —.
The dash introduces the lettered alternatives. This substitution does not itself change or omit the wording of those alternatives or their connecting or.
issues.proposed_resolution: Use an en dash, –, following unless to match the printed appearance.
issues.uncertainty: The raster supports the visual distinction in dash length, but does not establish the underlying encoded Unicode character.

findings: The heading number 8. is clearly printed before the underlined heading Streamlining Threshold. The right extraction omits the number.

issues.printed_text: 8.1    The SPI should specify a maximum threshold of investment, as an absolute amount or a percentage relative to the SPI’s assets under management (“AUM”) with the intermediary, that is acceptable to be executed under a Streamlined Approach (“Streamlining Threshold”).
findings: The paragraph number 8.1 is clearly printed in the left margin. The right extraction omits this identifier.

issues.printed_text: 8.2    SPI could specify a Streamlining Threshold appropriate to their circumstances and the intermediary is required to maintain proper records of setting any such threshold, including the SPI’s rationale that provides support for setting such threshold.
findings: The paragraph number 8.2 is clearly printed in the left margin. The right extraction omits this identifier.
